prompt: [INST] Describe how a virus spreads in three sentences. [/INST]
response: A virus spreads when it replicates itself and infects new cells, often through contact with bodily fluids or by hitchhiking on tiny respiratory droplets that are produced when an infected person talks, coughs, and sneezes. It can also spread through touching surfaces contaminated with the virus and then touching the mouth, nose, or eyes. Humans can facilitate the spread of the virus through close contact with others, travel, and not following proper hygiene and social distancing protocols.
